faction_multipliers.Wet Ledger member: x0.60 on barge and packet only

tariff.barter: NOT applicable. Fares are posted, never bartered; Disposition and Mercantile do not move them. Disposition < 30 makes a poler or barge-master REFUSE the fare outright (CF-C012 "refusable") — the social lever is access, not price.
tariff.note: Piecewise-linear in route metres, continuous and monotonic, from RI-PRG05 §2 anchors (1000 m = 12 g, 2500 m = 45 g, 6900 m = 90 g). Fares are posted, never bartered.
